summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload under a CSS-utilities cover
details: Package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated and, when `bun` is not present on PATH, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array-rotator obfuscation (large numeric/string array with a rotator function and `_0x`-style dispatchers). The package advertises itself as CSS utilities and has no need for a second language runtime; the use of a freshly downloaded alternate runtime is a known evasion for Node-based install scanners. The published name sits under the `@servicetitan` vendor scope but the shipped behavior (obfuscated preinstall, alternate-runtime dropper, opaque payload) is inconsistent with genuine vendor tooling, indicating scope impersonation. Installing the package causes attacker-controlled, obfuscated code of unknown function to execute on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
